free_tier.stated: 20,000 files per site on Free; 25 MiB max per file; 100 projects per account => ~488 GiB per project, ~48.8 TiB per account. No stated total-bytes cap.

egress.terms: Unlimited requests and unlimited bandwidth: 'Static asset requests ... are free and unlimited' (pages/functions/pricing) and 'Unlimited bandwidth ... no extra cost to you' (blog.cloudflare.com/big-ideas-on-pages).

tooling: wrangler pages deploy (official CLI, direct upload of a folder, no Git required); Cloudflare API v4 /accounts/:id/pages/projects/:name/deployments does multipart upload; rclone has no native 'pages' backend but can be driven via 'rclone serve http' + wrangler or a custom remote.
chaining: 100 projects per account (docs: 'limit of 100 projects per account. This limit is not routinely increased') x 20,000 files x 25 MiB. Unlimited free Cloudflare accounts x 100 projects. Workers Static Assets (100 Workers free, 20,000 files each) is a second, independent pool on the same account. Sharding is by file: any 10 TiB working set = ~420k shards of 25 MiB spread over ~21 projects.
limits_note: 25 MiB hard per file (no override on Free); 20,000 files per site on Free; 500 builds/month and 20-min build timeout if Git-driven; new-project creation throttled for the first 48h of a new account ('Cloudflare limits the number of new Pages projects you can create within your first 48 hours'); Functions requests draw from the 100k/day Workers quota, but pure static requests do not.
reliability_note: Assets stay cached on the CDN until the next deployment, so re-upload churn is the only real risk; no data-vanishing mechanism observed, and static serving is not rate-limited or billed.
